source_annotation.prompt: Take the lemon and put it on the second shelf

generation_prompt: The robot uses the hand entering from the lower-right edge to close its thumb and fingers around the lemon on the tablecloth and lift it. It carries the lemon to the open side of the white shelf unit facing the hand, inserts it into the second shelf level from the top, and opens its fingers to release it. The hand then withdraws and returns upright at the lower right, leaving the lemon resting in that shelf. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
